title: Growing Neural Gas topology growth
summary: A deterministic 2-D trace of prototype movement, competitive-Hebbian edges, local edge aging, and periodic error-driven insertion.
learning_objectives: Follow winner and topological-neighbor prototype movement in two dimensions.
See edge age increment before the winner/runner edge is created or reset.
Inspect periodic insertion between the largest-error prototype and its largest-error neighbor.
Distinguish GNG from GWR and topology/prototype growth from hidden-feature growth.
limitations: Not human-reviewed; this is an automated source-grounded teaching artifact.
It follows Fritzke's section 3 update order but does not reproduce the paper's datasets, parameters, random sampling, figures, or reported results.
Initial prototypes, finite input order, rates, insertion interval, edge-age limit, error factors, tie-breaking, and rounding are pinned demonstration choices.
The private source is an eight-page PostScript proceedings file; text extraction was custom and typography-damaged, so equations and symbols need human checking.
